questions.q: What units is latitude in for the wp command?
What flag does the last waypoint have?
The RTH action code in wp?
What does p1 of an RTH waypoint set?
questions.explain: For RTH p1 > 0 allows landing at home; p1 sets the speed in cm/s for an ordinary WAYPOINT.

questions.q: Why does INAV block arming with a mission loaded?
options: The first waypoint is too far away
Missions are forbidden without a compass
questions.explain: Protection against “yesterday's mission at a different field”.

questions.q: How do you save waypoints to EEPROM?
questions.explain: wp save also saves unsaved CLI settings.

options: The limit to the first waypoint
questions.explain: The first waypoint of the mission must be closer than 100 m to the arming point: protection against “yesterday's mission”.

questions.q: The waypoint radius nav_wp_radius for a fixed wing compared with a copter:
options: Larger than for a copter: 10–30 m
The same as for a copter: about 1 m
Zero: a fixed wing passes the waypoint exactly
Smaller than for a copter: 10–30 cm
questions.explain: A fixed wing does not stop and turns on an arc: 1000–3000 cm instead of 100 cm for a copter.
